name: ss33-skill-store-for-agents
description: Search about 60,000 agent skills in the SS33 Skill Store and follow the one that fits the task.

interface.longDescription:
Let your agent find the right verified skill at the right time.

SS33 Skill Store is a searchable library of more than 60,000 agent skills: step-by-step procedures written by practitioners and organisations. Hundreds are Verified: tested on blind everyday questions, where the skill measurably improved the model's answers.

Describe your task in a sentence and the store finds the closest skills and returns the one that fits: the procedure, the rules and numbers that matter, and the common mistakes to avoid. When nothing fits well, the search says so instead of returning a weak match.

Areas include software development, AI and agents, data and analytics, security, business, finance and markets, legal, health and life sciences, creative and media, science and education, and personal and home.

Three tools:
- Search the skill store: finds skills that match a task and explains why each matched.
- Get skill: returns a skill's SKILL.md and its supporting files.
- Report skill outcome: records whether a skill helped, which feeds its rating.

No account or sign-in is needed.
capabilities: Search 60,000 agent skills by describing a task in plain words
Return a skill's SKILL.md and supporting files
Say when no skill fits instead of returning a weak match
Rank skills from a chosen subject area higher
Record whether a skill helped, feeding its rating
defaultPrompt: Find a skill to set up a GitHub Actions pipeline that runs lint and tests on every pull request
Find a skill to write a job quote for a kitchen remodel with a deposit schedule
Find a skill to audit my Django app for security problems before launch

positive.description: Trade pricing: finds a verified quoting skill and applies its method.
positive.prompt: Search the SS33 Skill Store for a skill on quoting trade jobs, then use it to write a kitchen remodel quote with labour, materials, markup and a deposit schedule.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_skill_store with the task described in a sentence, then get_skill on skillstore33/trade-job-quote (returned first and marked verified). The answer follows that skill: burdened labour, material waste, overhead, contingency, and margin vs markup shown step by step, with one final price.

positive.description: Security audit: finds the verified Django security skill and follows its checklist.
positive.prompt: Search the SS33 Skill Store for a Django security audit skill, then use its checklist to tell me what to review in my Django app before launch.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_skill_store (area Security), then get_skill on skillstore33/django-security, returned first and marked verified. The answer uses that skill’s audit brief rather than generic advice: Django settings, per-view access, injection, XSS, CSRF and vulnerable dependencies.

positive.description: CI setup: finds a GitHub Actions skill and writes the workflow from it.
positive.prompt: Search the SS33 Skill Store for a GitHub Actions CI skill, then use it to write a workflow that runs lint and tests on every pull request.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_skill_store (area Software Development), then get_skill on one of the GitHub Actions CI skills returned — for example patricio0312rev/github-actions-pipeline-creator or spencerpauly/setting-up-ci. Produces a workflow YAML with lint and test jobs triggered on pull_request. Any of the returned CI skills is an acceptable choice.

positive.description: E-commerce templating: finds a Shopify Liquid skill and writes a section with a schema.
positive.prompt: Search the SS33 Skill Store for a Shopify Liquid skill, then use it to write a section that shows a featured collection on my theme home page.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_skill_store, then get_skill on a Shopify Liquid skill. Produces a .liquid section file including a valid {% schema %} block with settings, so it can be added to the theme.

positive.description: Legal drafting: finds an NDA skill and drafts from its structure.
positive.prompt: Search the SS33 Skill Store for an NDA drafting skill, then use it to draft a mutual non-disclosure agreement for talks with a potential supplier.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_skill_store (area Legal), then get_skill on an NDA drafting skill — phuryn/draft-nda and claude-office-skills/nda-generator are both returned. Produces a mutual NDA covering the definition of confidential information, exclusions, term, return or destruction, and governing law, with a note that it is not legal advice.

negative.description: Live data, not a stored procedure. No skill can answer it, so the plugin should not be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Casual conversation with nothing to look up. No search should be made.
negative.prompt: Tell me a joke about cats.

negative.description: A one-line answer the model gives directly. Searching the store would waste a turn.

publication.release_notes: First release: search 60,000+ agent skills by task description, fetch a skill and its files, and report whether it helped.
